field_docs.gross_cost_gbp: Sum of the published Gross Cost in GBP, rounded to pence: "the basic price of a drug, i.e. the price listed in the National Drug Tariff, concessionary price list, or in standard price lists" (BSO). Late concessionary prices are included from May 2024
field_docs.actual_cost_gbp: Sum of the published Actual Cost in GBP, rounded to pence (definition in the BSO user guidance, https://gpdatasets.hscni.net/)

field_docs.date: Date of the question in the official record (YYYY-MM-DD). Window: 2020-01-01 to the date of collection
field_docs.question_ref: Parliamentary question reference number printed at the end of the question (e.g. 73302/26: number / two-digit year); empty when none is printed
field_docs.question_number: Question number on that day's order paper (oral) or written-answers list
field_docs.house: House and term as published (e.g. 34th Dáil)
field_docs.department: The API's short label of the department the question is addressed to: Health, Enterprise (Department of Enterprise, Trade and Employment and successors) or Business (Department of Business, Enterprise and Innovation, to mid-2020)
field_docs.topic: Heading of the debate section the question is filed under, as published (e.g. Medicinal Products, Drugs Payment Scheme, Hospital Services)
field_docs.question_text: Question text as published, without the opening clause naming the asking member: it starts at "Minister for Health ..." (Irish-language questions at "Aire ..."). Questions whose opening does not follow the standard form are not published. The rest is the official record verbatim and can mention organisations or people (often as "(details supplied)")
field_docs.matched_terms: Topic terms found in question_text or topic (case-insensitive, whole words): medicine (medicine, medicines, medicinal, medication), drug (drug, drugs; includes illicit-drug questions), HPRA (HPRA, Health Products Regulatory Authority), pharmaceutical (pharmaceutical(s), pharma), pharmacy (pharmacy, pharmacies, pharmacist(s)), clinical trial, vaccine (vaccin*), reimbursement (reimburs*, NCPE, pharmacoeconomic*). A question is kept when at least one term matches
field_docs.url: URI of the question in the Oireachtas data model (data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/question/...); a persistent identifier, it does not open as a web page
field_docs.web_url: Page of the question on oireachtas.ie, built from date and question_number (https://www.oireachtas.ie/en/debates/question/{date}/{number}/)
field_docs.record_xml_url: Official record (Akoma Ntoso XML) of the debate section that holds the question and its answer, as published by the API

field_docs.source_file: Which published file the row comes from: sfi_2000_2024 = Science Foundation Ireland grant commitments, 2000 to 31 July 2024 (final); research_ireland = Research Ireland grant commitments (from August 2024; current file runs to January 2026)
field_docs.grant_id: Grant (proposal / project) identifier as published, e.g. 12/RC/2275_P2
field_docs.sub_programme: Sub-programme (SFI file only; empty in the Research Ireland file)
field_docs.supplement: Supplement type, e.g. STAR Supplement (SFI file only); empty for a main award
field_docs.research_body: Research body (organisation) holding the grant, as published
field_docs.research_body_ror: ROR identifier URL of the research body (SFI file only)
field_docs.funder: Funder name as published (Science Foundation Ireland or Research Ireland)
field_docs.funder_ror: ROR identifier URL of the funder (Research Ireland file only)
field_docs.funder_crossref_id: Crossref Funder Registry DOI of the funder (SFI file only)
field_docs.title: Project / proposal title as published, except that personal names are replaced by [name withheld]
field_docs.title_redacted: yes when a personal name was removed from the title, else no
field_docs.start_date: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD); Research Ireland's 'Actual Start Date' converted from month/day/year
field_docs.end_date: End date (YYYY-MM-DD); Research Ireland's 'Final End Date' converted from month/day/year
field_docs.amount_eur: Amount in euro as published (negative values are published de-commitments / adjustments; accounting-style (x) is read as -x)
field_docs.amount_basis: What amount_eur measures: 'Current Total Commitment' (SFI file) or 'Award Amount' (Research Ireland file). Do not treat the two as identical measures
